# Greatley design system

## Clarity visual system

`clarity.css` is the final global stylesheet for all ten applications. It provides the shared Messages-inspired white/neutral surfaces, system typography, capsule actions/search, compact people rows, separators, accessible focus and dark theme. Public tokens remain unlayered; the `gp-clarity` layer handles legacy important declarations. Authored document, spreadsheet and slide content is excluded from UI typography rules. See Astra `docs/visual-system.md` for component standards.
